_doc: Named camera poses of the landmarks (P2-007; GAME.md 'Level design rules': each hero landmark has a first-sight shot on a mission route, and 'Game roles of hero landmarks': photo spots). World metres x, z of the eye (its height is the ground there plus eyeM, the player's eye on foot, 1.7 m) and the point looked at: a landmark id with `up` metres above its foot and an optional offset [dx, dz]. `route` names the mission route or road the eye stands on (harness/data/fixtures/city_routes.json, harness/data/milestones.json). The shot script harness/verify/scripts/landmark_heroes.js stages the player there (teleport), sets the camera and takes the shot `shot`. Kinds: first_sight (the reveal on a route), near (silhouette and carving), far (the skyline mark).

india_gate_first_sight.route: rajpath (Kartavya Path eastbound, the end of the route at the hexagon)

india_gate_near.route: the paved walk west of the arch inside the hexagon

india_gate_far_1500.route: Kartavya Path 1.5 km west of the arch

india_gate_far_2500.route: Kartavya Path 2.5 km west of the arch (the far silhouette)

red_fort_first_sight.route: Netaji Subhash Marg at the Chandni Chowk crossing (the Act 1 finale route, milestones.json: the getaway through Netaji Subhas Marg toward the Red Fort)

red_fort_chandni_chowk.route: chandni_main (Chandni Chowk main road at its east end)

cp_circle_colonnade.route: cp_lap (the Connaught Place inner circle, clockwise)

jama_masjid_east.route: the road along the north-east of the mosque grounds (Meena Bazaar side), toward Netaji Subhash Marg: the east and north gates, the domes and both minarets
